edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
